appRefusedHint: Nothing is wrong with your account, and trying again will not help. Please let your administrator know.
appRefusedLead: This application cannot sign you in here
appRefusedReturn: The application asked to send you back to an address it is not allowed to use. Your administrator must bind the application's route to its client in the console, with OIDC sign-in.
appRefusedUnavailable: Signing in to applications is not set up here yet. Your administrator must declare a public name for applications in the console, under Domains & TLS.
appRefusedUnknown: The application that sent you here is not set up to sign in here. Your administrator must declare it as a client in the console, under Routes, OIDC / JWT.
appRefusedUnreadable: The sign-in request the application sent could not be read. Your administrator must have the application send a valid OpenID Connect request.
authoritiesHint: Connect an account you already have elsewhere, and use it to sign in here.
backWithinDay: Service should be back within a day or so.
backWithinDays: Service should be back within a few days.
backWithinHour: Service should be back within the hour.
backWithinHours: Service should be back within a few hours.
backupHint: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe: they won't be shown again.
challengeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, one of your backup codes, or a code we e-mail you.
chooseGroupLead: Choose the group to work as
chooseTenantLead: Choose the tenant to work in
confirmedHint: You can sign in now. An administrator still has to grant you access.
emailChangeSent: A confirmation link was sent to %s. Your address changes once it is confirmed.
emailChangeCodeHint: A code has just been sent to the new address. Enter it here: your address changes once it is confirmed. It is valid for %s, and only in this browser.
emailHint: Used to get you back in if you lose your password.
errAccessEnded: This access ended on %s. Ask your administrator to extend it.
errTemporaryExpired: This temporary password has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.
errAccessNotOpen: This access opens on %s. Sign in again from that day, or ask your administrator.
errAvatarType: Use a png, jpeg or webp image
errBadCode: That code is not valid. Check it and try again.
errBadCodeRetry: That code is not valid. Try again.
errBadEmail: This is not a valid email address. Check it and try again.
errBadKey: This is not a valid public SSH key. Paste the content of your .pub file.
errBadTimezone: That timezone is not one this server knows. Choose one from the list.
errCaptcha: The digits do not match the image: try this new one.
errCaptchaNeeded: Too many failed sign-ins on this account: copy the digits of the image as well.
errConfirmExpired: This confirmation link is invalid or expired: sign in to receive a fresh one.
errEmailChangeExpired: This link is invalid or expired: change your address again from your profile.
errEmailTaken: Another account already uses this address. Use a different one.
errGroupForbidden: That group is not yours to choose. Choose one from the list.
errIdentityTaken: That account is already connected to somebody else here. Connect a different one, or ask your administrator.
errInvalidCreds: Invalid username or password. Check them and try again.
errLastWayIn: This is your only way in: set a password first.
errMfaRequiredOff: Two-factor is required and cannot be turned off. You can replace your authenticator instead.
errNotInvited: You are recognised, but no account has been created for you here yet. Ask your administrator to create one.
errOutsideHours: Access refused: outside your working hours. Sign in again during them, or ask your administrator.
errPasskey: The passkey sign-in failed. Try again, or use your password.
errPwCurrentWrong: Your current password is incorrect. Check it and try again.
errPwMismatch: The two entries do not match. Type the same password twice.
errPwPolicy: Your password does not meet the rules below.
errPwReused: You have used this password before. Choose one you have not used.
errRegisterMissing: Username and email are required. Fill in both.
errResetExpired: This reset link is invalid or expired: ask for a fresh one from the sign-in page.
errSignInExpired: The sign-in attempt expired: please start again.
errSignInUnavailable: This sign-in method is unavailable right now. Try again later; if it keeps failing, tell your administrator.
errSigninCode: This code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errTenantForbidden: That tenant is not available to your account. Choose one from the list.
errTenantRefused: Access to %s is refused: outside your working hours. Make another choice, or come back during them.
errTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts: try again later.
forgotHint: Enter your account's email address: a reset link will be sent to it (valid 1 hour).
forgotSentHint: If this address matches an account, a reset link has been sent to it. The link expires in 1 hour.
issueCaptureFailed: Screen capture failed. Try again, or send the report without it.
issueCaptureHint: The capture is sent only with your report. You can crop it first.
issueContextNote: The page address and browser details are attached to your report.
issueTooLarge: The screenshot is too large to send. Crop it, or remove it.
leaveBody: You will lose access to %s and to what it grants you. Only one of its administrators can add you back.
linkValid24h: This link is valid for 24 hours.
linkValid48h: This link is valid for 48 hours.
linkValid7d: This link is valid for 7 days.
mailConfirmIntro: Confirm your address to finish creating your account.
mailConfirmCodeIntro: Enter this code on the page where you created your account to confirm your address.
mailConfirmOutro: If you did not create this account, ignore this message.
mailEmailChangeIntro: Confirm this address to make it the one your %s account uses.
mailEmailChangeCodeIntro: Enter this code on your %s profile to make this address the one your account uses.
mailEmailChangeOutro: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your address stays as it was.
mailEmailChangingIntro: Someone asked to change the address of your %[1]s account to %[2]s. Nothing changes until that address is confirmed.
mailEmailChangingOutro: If this was not you, change your password now.
mailNewAccountBody:
The account %q (%s) confirmed its address on %s and awaits access.

Grant it roles or a tenant in the console, Users section.
mailOtpIntro: Enter this code to finish signing in to %s.
mailOtpOutro: If you are not signing in, ignore this message and consider changing your password.
mailPwChangedBody:
The password of your %s account was just changed and every open session was signed out.

If this was not you, use the sign-in page's password reset immediately and warn your administrator.
mailSigninAttemptsIntro: Someone tried several times to sign in to your %s account with a wrong password.
mailSigninAttemptsOutro: Signing in to this account now also asks you to copy digits from an image; your account is not locked. If it was not you, change your password.
mailResetIntro: A password reset was requested for your %s account. Choose a new password with the button below. This link is valid for 1 hour.
mailResetCodeIntro: A password reset was requested for your %s account. Enter this code on the page where you asked for it to choose a new password.
mailResetOutro: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password is unchanged.
mailInviteIntro: An account has been created for you on %s. Choose your password with the button below to sign in.
mailInviteOutro: If you were not expecting this invitation, ignore this message: nobody can sign in with it unless the password is chosen.
mailResetAdminIntro: An administrator has reset the password of your %s account. Choose a new one with the button below.
mailResetAdminOutro: Your current password keeps working until you choose a new one.
maintenanceAdmin:
As an administrator, you can still open the application.
Everyone else sees this page.
maintenanceStripe: Under maintenance. Visitors see the unavailable page; you can get through as an administrator.
mfaRequiredNote: Two-factor is required by your administrator and can't be turned off.
mfaStatus: Two-factor is active. Backup codes remaining: %d of %d.
mfaManageCodeHint: Enter a current code, or a backup code if you lost your phone, to change these settings.
noWayIn: Signing in is not available. Please contact your administrator.
otpSendByEmail: Send a code to my e-mail
otpSent: We e-mailed you a code. Enter it above - it is valid for 10 minutes.
pendingHint: An administrator has been notified and must grant you access. Come back later, or use the public areas below.
reasonIncident: A technical incident is being dealt with.
reasonUpgrade: An update is being rolled out.
refusedApps: No application is open to your account yet.
refusedHint: You are signed in and nothing is wrong with your account. If you should have access, ask your administrator.
refusedLead: This page is not open to you
refusedOther: An access rule does not let you in.
refusedRoles: It asks for a role your account does not have.
refusedTenant: It is reserved to another tenant.
refusedUser: It is open to specific accounts only.
registerSentHint: If this address is valid, a confirmation link has been sent to it. The link expires in 24 hours.
registerCodeHint: If this address can be used, a code has just been sent to it. Enter it here: it is valid for %s, and only in this browser.
resetDoneHint: Every open session has been signed out; sign in with your new password.
scanHint: Scan this with an authenticator app, or enter the key by hand, then type the 6-digit code to confirm.
sessionsHint: Everywhere your account is signed in right now. Signing out a session ends it at once.
signOutLead: A page asked to sign you out. This signs you out of every application in this browser.
signinCodeHint: Enter your e-mail address and we will send you a code. No password needed.
signinCodeLink: Sign in with a code by e-mail
signinCodeSentHint: If this address matches an account, a code has just been sent to it. It is valid for %s, and only in this browser.
tokenContext: New tokens act in this context:
tokenCreatedWarn: This is the only time it is shown. Store it somewhere safe; anyone with it can call the API as you.
tokenNoTenant: Without an active tenant, a token carries your identity but no roles.
tokenRevokeConfirm: Anything using this token will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
whyNamed: That page is open to specific people only, and your account is not one of them. If you should have access, ask your administrator.
whyOtherTenant: That page belongs to another tenant. Choose the one it is served for.
whyRoles: That page needs roles you do not have in this tenant. You may have them in another one.
notifDeleteAllText: They will be gone for good, on all your devices.
notifEmptyHint: New messages from your applications will appear here.
notifDesktopBlocked: Desktop notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
notifDeleteAllEvery: Delete all notifications of every tenant?
notifNoMatchHint: Change the search or the filters.
notFoundHint: Nothing answers at this address. The link may be out of date, or the address mistyped.
notFoundMenu: Choose an application from the menu to carry on.
notFoundPick: Choose an application to carry on.
notFoundSignIn: Sign in to reach your applications.
